response_options.label: Strike on a Sunday, when the foreign experts are expected to be away
response_options.desc: Eight F-16s with F-15 escorts, timed so that few if any of the 100-120 foreign experts are at the site: the plan as carried out on 7 June. Larger lessons for the air force; the diplomatic cost as history records it.

cite.quote: According to the government, the raid was planned for Sunday when it was expected that none if any of the 100 to 120 foreign experts working on the reactor would be at the site.

response_options.label: Strike on 10 May as first planned, the day of the French presidential election
response_options.desc: The original date. Opposition leader Shimon Peres objected to bombing a French-built reactor on the day France voted: half again as much damage to Standing abroad.

cite.quote: Peres replied that he had not opposed the planned raid but its original timing for May 10, the day of the French Presidential elections.

response_options.label: Carry it out with the aircraft already assigned, without extra funding
response_options.desc: No extra money for training and spare aircraft: the strike goes ahead as history records, but the air force learns less (Readiness lesson -1).

cite.quote: since the Israeli planes flew over Saudi Arabia on their way to Iraq
